$comment: OpenSetlist dev seed — curated PUBLIC DOMAIN hymns (texts pre-1930, PD in the US) for manual testing. Run `pnpm -C api db:seed` before a test pass: it wipes the group's songs/tags and re-imports this file. Each section's content is ABC 2.1: quoted chord symbols inline on music lines, lyrics on w: lines with one syllable per note (hyphen-joined syllables within a word). Melodies are simplified dev harmonizations, not authoritative settings. Alpha seeding with the team's real repertoire stays with issue #17.
